p_str, k_str = stdin.readline().rstrip().split(' ')

k = int(k_str)

    result = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
    print(result)

    print(result)

    order = 1
    while n != 1:
        n = (n * k) % p
        order += 1
    loops = (p - 1) // order
